data.one_liner: Geo-measurements utilities for area, distance, heading, and polygon operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility functions such as SphericalUtil and PolygonUtil ported from android-maps-utils. It calculates distances, areas, headings, offsets, and polygon containments using latitude and longitude coordinates.
use_when: You need to calculate distances or areas between geographic coordinates in Dart or Flutter.
You want to check if a point lies inside a polygon or on a path.
You need to encode or decode polyline strings.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete map rendering widget (use flutter_map or google_maps_flutter instead).
You need active location tracking of the device.
strengths: Pure Dart library with no external dependencies.
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Comprehensive port of well-tested Android maps utility algorithms.
weaknesses: Does not render maps or handle UI components by itself.
Does not provide device location tracking features.

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative pure Dart geo-computation and distance calculation library often used alongside flutter_map.
